In 1999 the middle class made $45k - $135k and accounted for 55% of the population. 

That's the equivalent to $90k - $270k today, which only accounts for 37% of the population. 

The $55k - $167k that marks the middle class today is the equivalent to 1999's lower to lower middle class.
